id: Unique identifier for each CRE or CMBS data entry. Used as a primary key for database operations and record tracking.
name: Name of the individual, entity, or property associated with the CRE or CMBS data entry. Useful for identification and reference purposes.
age: Age of the individual associated with the CRE or CMBS data, or the age of the property in years. Provides context for risk assessment or property valuation.
city: City where the commercial real estate property is located or where the CMBS is issued. Important for local market analysis and geographical segmentation.
timestamp: Date and time when the CRE or CMBS data entry was recorded or last updated. Crucial for tracking data freshness and historical analysis.
email: Email address of the individual associated with the commercial real estate or CMBS data entry. Used for communication and identification purposes.
phone_number: Contact phone number for the individual or entity associated with the CRE or CMBS data entry. Useful for direct communication and verification.
country: The country where the commercial real estate property is located or where the CMBS is issued. Important for geographical analysis and regulatory considerations.
